mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_card_id, uc.card_product_id, uc.display_order, cp.card_name, cp.card_image_url, i.card_company_name FROM user_card uc JOIN card_product cp ON cp.card_product_id = uc.card_product_id JOIN issuer i ON i.issuer_id = cp.issuer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY uc.display_order, uc.user_card_id

SELECT bs.service_id, bs.plan_group_id, bs.benefit_name, bs.benefit_type, bs.value_type, bs.value_number, pc.currency_name, pc.krw_per_point, (bs.min_payment_amount <= #{prevMonthSpend} AND (bs.max_payment_amount IS NULL OR #{prevMonthSpend} < bs.max_payment_amount)) AS tier_ok FROM benefit_service bs LEFT JOIN point_currency pc ON pc.point_currency_id = bs.point_currency_id WHERE bs.card_product_id = #{cardProductId} AND ( (bs.scope_type = 'BRAND' AND #{storeBrandId} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_brand sb WHERE sb.service_id = bs.service_id AND sb.brand_id = #{storeBrandId})) OR (bs.scope_type = 'INDUSTRY' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_category sc WHERE sc.service_id = bs.service_id AND sc.category_id = #{storeCategoryId})) )

SELECT bl.tier_id, bl.limit_basis, bl.limit_period, bl.limit_value FROM benefit_tier bt JOIN benefit_limit bl ON bl.tier_id = bt.tier_id WHERE (bt.plan_group_id = #{planGroupId} OR (#{planGroupId} IS NULL AND bt.service_id = #{serviceId})) AND bt.min_prev_month_spend <= #{prevMonthSpend} AND (bt.max_prev_month_spend IS NULL OR #{prevMonthSpend} < bt.max_prev_month_spend)
